title: Supporting Women’s Well-Being, Strengthening Teams
summary: Supporting women's wellbeing means ensuring employees know where to turn for support and feel comfortable seeking help.
body_markdown:
**By Kim Chhay, Quality Engineer**


Supporting women’s wellbeing means more than providing benefits. It means ensuring employees know where to turn for support and creating[a workplace culture](https://novanta.com/careers-culture/life-at-novanta/) where people feel comfortable seeking help when they need it.


That was the focus of Women’s Health Month in October, when the Bedford Women’s ERG led an awareness campaign highlighting resources available through the Sun Life Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Bright Horizons. These programs offer support for emotional wellbeing, family care, financial planning, legal guidance, and a variety of other life needs that can have a meaningful impact on employees both inside and outside of work.


Many employees are familiar with these programs by name but may not realize the full range of services available. Throughout the month, the Women’s ERG helped raise awareness through educational materials, conversations, and engagement activities designed to connect employees with resources that could benefit them and their families. Resources include confidential counseling, childcare and elder care support, tutoring services, financial resources, and support for new parents.


The campaign also featured Wear Pink for Awareness activities and wellness-themed giveaways including pink bag popcorn, organic snacks, bracelets, daily affirmation cards, and candy.


While the initiative focused on women’s health and wellbeing, its impact extended beyond the month itself. By encouraging employees to learn about available resources and engage in conversations about wellness, the event helped strengthen the sense of support and connection across the site.


The effort reflects our belief that great teams are built through collaboration and care for one another. Just as employees work together to solve challenges every day, they also support one another by sharing resources and fostering an environment where everyone can succeed.


The success of the initiative was made possible through contributions from employees across the site. Special thanks to the Benefits Team for developing the flyers and graphics that helped communicate key information and increase awareness, as well as everyone who helped support the campaign.


When employees feel supported at work and at home, they are better positioned to contribute, collaborate, and bring their best to their teams. Initiatives like Women’s Health Month help strengthen those connections while reinforcing a culture where wellbeing matters
